title.en: Thirty-seven small galaxies and their missing oxygen
title.zh: 三十七座小星系，氧去了哪里

summary.en: NASA’s November2report highlights GLOW’s oxygen census:37nearby gas-rich dwarf galaxies retain about4–25%of their estimated stellar oxygen production. The older August preprint and uncertain destination stay explicit.
summary.zh: NASA11月2日报道GLOW氧元素普查：37座邻近富气矮星系，约保留恒星预计产氧量的4%至25%；保留8月预印本时间与氧的去向之疑。

title.en: Swift’s final countdown after an orbit rescue failed
title.zh: 抢救轨道失败后，Swift进入最后倒数

summary.en: NASA’s November2update forecasts Swift’s atmospheric return on November4,with substantial timing uncertainty. Nearly22years of science and a failed commercial boost attempt expose the limits of rescuing an aging spacecraft.
summary.zh: NASA11月2日更新预计Swift于11月4日重返大气层，时间仍有较大误差。近22年科研与一次失败的商业抬轨尝试，留下老卫星抢救的难题。
